rules.requirement: Short title: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. Came into force on 1st April, 2011.
rules.violation: N/A - Title provision

rules.requirement: Defines Dealer, E-commerce, E-commerce Entity, Marketplace Model, Industrial Consumer, Institutional Consumer, Manufacturer, Maximum Permissible Error, Net Quantity, Packer, Principal Display Panel, Retail Package, Retail Sale Price, Wholesale Package, Unit Sale Price.
rules.applicability: All legal terms used under PCR 2011
rules.violation: Misclassification of consumer or package type

rules.requirement: Chapter II retail declarations do not apply to: (a) Packages containing > 25 kg or 25 L; (b) Cement, fertilizer, and agricultural farm produce in bags > 50 kg; (c) Packaged commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers.
rules.condition: Packages exceeding 25kg/25L or 50kg for cement/fertilizers/agricultural produce
rules.violation: Misapplying retail exemptions to retail consumer packages <= 25 kg/L.

rules.requirement: No person shall pre-pack, sell, distribute, deliver, or display for sale any pre-packaged commodity unless compliant with mandatory declarations securely affixed to the package.
rules.violation: Sale, distribution, or storage of non-compliant pre-packaged commodities.

rules.requirement: Recommended standard pack sizes specified in Second Schedule (Omitted vide GSR 226(E) dated 28.03.2022 w.e.f. 01.10.2022).
rules.violation: Historical non-standard pack size violation

rules.requirement: Name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer or importer must be prominently printed on PDP. Complete address includes registered office / factory postal address with PIN code.
rules.violation: Missing or incomplete manufacturer/packer/importer name or address.

rules.requirement: Name of the Country of Origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products must be stated on the package.
rules.violation: Absence of Country of Origin on imported package.

rules.requirement: Common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package must be declared on PDP.
rules.exception: Single item packages clearly visible through transparent wrapper
rules.violation: Missing generic/common name on package label.

rules.requirement: Net quantity in standard unit of weight (g, kg), volume (ml, l), length (cm, m), area (sq m), or number (N, piece, pair, set) must be declared.
rules.violation: Missing net quantity or use of non-standard metric symbols (e.g. gms, ltrs).

rules.requirement: Month and year of manufacture must be declared (w.e.f 2022). For commodities unfit for consumption after time, 'Best before or Use by date, month and year' must be declared.
rules.violation: Missing month/year of manufacture or missing Best Before / Use By date.

rules.requirement: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes must be declared in Indian currency format (e.g. MRP Rs. XX.XX / ₹ XX.XX incl. of all taxes). Price rounding off to nearest rupee/paise.
rules.violation: Missing MRP, non-inclusive of taxes statement, price smudging, or dual MRP.

rules.requirement: Name, address, telephone number, and email ID of the person or office to be contacted in case of consumer complaints must be declared.
rules.exception: Small packages <= 10g/10ml where outer multipack declares details
rules.violation: Missing consumer helpline phone number, email address, or contact address.

rules.requirement: Barcode, GTIN, QR Code, e-code for net quantity assurance, or government scheme logos (e.g. Swachh Bharat) are permissible in addition to mandatory declarations.
rules.condition: In addition to mandatory Rule 6(1) declarations
rules.exception: Cannot replace mandatory physical text declarations on retail packages.
rules.violation: Attempting to substitute mandatory printed MRP/Net Qty with QR code alone on non-electronic retail goods.

rules.requirement: (1) Packages containing GM food must bear 'GM' at top of PDP. (2) Packages containing soaps, shampoos, toothpastes, cosmetics, and toiletries must bear a red/brown dot for non-veg origin or green dot for veg origin.
rules.applicability: GM food, cosmetics, soaps, shampoos, toiletries
rules.violation: Missing GM symbol or missing green/brown veg/non-veg dot on cosmetics.

rules.requirement: E-Commerce entities must ensure all mandatory declarations specified in Rule 6(1) (except month & year of manufacture) are displayed on the digital marketplace platform prior to purchase.
rules.applicability: All e-commerce platforms selling pre-packaged goods in India
rules.exception: Marketplace intermediary safe harbor applies if platform acts solely as facilitator under IT Act 2000.
rules.violation: Missing mandatory declarations (MRP, Net Qty, Country of Origin, Generic Name) on e-commerce product detail page.

rules.requirement: Unit Sale Price in Rupees (rounded to 2 decimal places) must be declared as: per g (if <1kg) / per kg (if >1kg); per ml (if <1L) / per L (if >1L); per cm (if <1m) / per m (if >1m); per number/unit.
rules.exception: Not required if retail sale price equals unit sale price (e.g. 1 kg pack). Exempt for alcoholic beverages.
rules.violation: Missing Unit Sale Price declaration on qualifying retail packages.

rules.requirement: Minimum height of numerals and letters on PDP must comply with Table-I: (1) Area A <= 50 sq cm: min 1.0 mm (1.5 mm if blown/molded); (2) 50 < A <= 100: min 1.5 mm; (3) 100 < A <= 500: min 2.5 mm; (4) 500 < A <= 2500: min 4.0 mm; (5) A > 2500 sq cm: min 6.0 mm. Width of numeral/letter shall not be less than one-third of height.
rules.applicability: Principal Display Panel font sizing for all retail packages
rules.violation: Font height smaller than statutory minimum required for PDP surface area.

rules.requirement: (1) Declarations must appear on PDP with surrounding space around net quantity equal to numeral height above/below and 2x height left/right. (2) Declarations must be in Hindi (Devnagri) or English. (3) Numerals must contrast conspicuously with background.
rules.applicability: Placement, legibility, and contrast of declarations
rules.exception: Blown/molded text on glass/plastic containers exempt from contrasting color.
rules.violation: Low contrast illegible font, obscured text, or missing English/Hindi text.

rules.requirement: (1) No retail dealer or wholesaler shall sell any pre-packaged commodity at a price exceeding MRP. (2) Dual MRP on identical pre-packaged commodities is strictly prohibited. (3) Price smudging/overwriting stickers prohibited. (4) All GST retailers dealing in weight/volume commodities must maintain Class-III electronic weighing scale with printed receipt facility free of cost for consumers.
rules.applicability: All retail dealers, wholesalers, and importers
rules.exception: Lowering MRP via transparent sticker is permitted if original MRP is not covered.
rules.violation: Overcharging above printed MRP, dual MRP printing, smudged price tag, or lack of Class-III check scale.

rules.requirement: Nothing in PCR 2011 applies to: (a) Net weight/measure <= 10g or 10ml (except tobacco products); (b) Fast food items packed by restaurant/hotel; (c) Formulated drugs covered under DPCO 2013; (d) Thread sold in coil to handloom weavers.
rules.condition: Net quantity <= 10g/ml or restaurant fast food or DPCO drugs
rules.violation: Attempting to issue non-compliance notice to legally exempt small packages.

rules.requirement: Every manufacturer, packer, or importer of pre-packaged commodities must register their name and complete premises address with the Director of Legal Metrology (Central) or Controller (State) within 90 days of commencement. Application fee: Rs. 500.
rules.applicability: All manufacturers, packers, and importers of packaged goods in India
rules.condition: Commencement of pre-packaging or import operations
rules.violation: Operating pre-packaging or import business without mandatory Registration Certificate.

rules.requirement: (1) Rule 32: Whoever contravenes any provision of PCR 2011 for which no punishment is provided in the Act shall be punished with fine of Rs. 5,000. (2) Rule 32A: Compounding fees table for PCR rules. (3) First Schedule: Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) tables. (4) Fifth Schedule: Sample Selection Table. (5) Sixth Schedule: Corrected Average formula Xc = mean + (sigma x C).
rules.applicability: General penalty clause and statutory measurement schedules
rules.condition: Non-compliance with PCR rules without specific Act penalty
rules.violation: General contravention of Packaged Commodities Rules 2011.

exemptions.description: Packages containing net quantity 10g or 10ml or less are exempt from declaring individual mandatory details on the small package if displayed on multi-piece outer package.
Wholesale packages are exempt from retail price (MRP) declaration requirements specified for retail packages under Chapter II.
exemptions.condition: Package intended strictly for wholesale trade or distribution

exemptions.description: Packages sold directly to industrial consumers (e.g. raw material drums, industrial chemicals) are exempt from Chapter II retail packaging rules.
exemptions.condition: Direct supply to industrial consumer for use in manufacturing or processing

exemptions.description: Unpackaged food items prepared for immediate consumption served at hotels or restaurants are exempt from packaged commodity declarations.
exemptions.condition: Unpackaged hot food or fast food served for immediate consumption

exemptions.description: Agricultural produce packed in packages of quantity exceeding 50 kg is exempt from retail packaged commodity rules.
exemptions.condition: Package quantity > 50 kg for agricultural produce
